sources.title: Corki Build Guide: The One True Corki Guide [ALL ROLES]

passive.name: Hextech Munitions
passive.text: A percentage of Corki's basic attack damage is dealt as bonus true damage.

spells.name: Phosphorus Bomb
spells.text: Corki fires a flash bomb at a target location, dealing magic damage to enemies in the area. This attack additionally reveals units in the area for a duration.

spells.name: Valkyrie
spells.text: Corki flies a short distance, dropping bombs that create a trail of fire that damages opponents who remain in it.

spells.name: Gatling Gun
spells.text: Corki's gatling gun rapidly fires in a cone in front of him, dealing damage and reducing enemy Armor and Magic Resist.

spells.name: Missile Barrage
spells.text: Corki fires a missile toward his target location that explodes on impact, dealing damage to enemies in an area. Corki stores missiles over time, up to a maximum. Every 3rd missile fired will be a Big One, dealing extra damage.

damage.value: Corki combines burst magic damage from Phosphorus Bomb with sustained damage from Valkyrie’s fire trail and bonus true damage on basic attacks.

archetype.value: Corki can play ADC, support, or jungle, using W to reposition while dealing damage.

axis.value: Corki can harass in lane, then use W to disengage and turn a trade.

winCondition.value: Corki can get ahead through early jungle harassment, ganks, and R snipes.

spikes.why: Corki can use R to stop recalls and snipe kills.
Corki’s Big One deals extra damage.

bait.why: Corki loses the escape and repositioning tool the guide relies on when W is spent.
Once Corki uses Gatling Gun, its 12-second cooldown leaves him without its damage and resistance reduction.
